Assistant Professor of Government and Public Policy at Hamilton College.

I was raised in Oklahoma, studied as an undergraduate at Hendrix College, and
took my PhD at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.

Away from the desk I am usually in the middle of some new enthusiasm, though two
have outlasted the others: I collect records, and I climb rock. I also tinker
with computers, the hobby that most easily disguises itself as work. Some of it
even is.
